question.text: Which of the following actions would NEGATIVELY impact a person's credit score?

answer.text: Paying all loan EMIs on time
Having a healthy mix of secured and unsecured credit
High utilization of credit card limits and frequent loan enquiries

explanation.text: The Logic: High credit card utilization relative to limits, too much unsecured credit, and excessive credit enquiries all negatively impact the credit score. On-time payments, a healthy mix of secured and unsecured credit, and periodic review of one's credit report help maintain or improve the score. The Trap: All four options sound related to credit behaviour, but only the combination of high utilization plus frequent enquiries is consistently flagged as harmful. Note: The general principle is that credit utilization should be kept low and credit enquiries should be made only when required and in moderation.
